meta.title: 蟹逅巴厘岛｜一边是数字游民的狂欢，一边是岛民的虔诚祈祷
meta.title_en: Crab Encounters Bali | Digital Nomads' Party vs. Islanders' Devotion
meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 巴厘岛数字游民

scenes.title_cn: 开场：按下暂停键的巴厘岛之旅
scenes.context: 博主在上海总被事情塞满，一直想给自己按暂停键却按不下去，所以这次跑来了巴厘岛，想看看这里到底是不是工作与生活完美的平衡点。语域：独白式旁白，带反思。
sentences: 我在上海的每一天，好像总能被事情塞满。
Every day in Shanghai, my schedule seems to get completely packed.
get packed（被塞满）；my schedule（日程）
我老觉得我得给自己按个暂停键，可我就是按不下去。
I keep feeling I should hit pause, but I just can't seem to press it.
hit pause（按暂停键）；can't seem to（就是没法）
我倒是要看看这里，到底是不是工作与生活完美的平衡点。
I wanted to see whether this place is really the perfect work-life balance.
work-life balance（工作与生活的平衡）；perfect balance（完美的平衡）
paraphrase: 被事情塞满 → get completely packed / my schedule is jam-packed
packed · jam-packed
按暂停键 → hit pause / press pause on life
hit pause · press pause
scenes.speak: Every day in Shanghai, my schedule seems to get completely packed. I keep feeling I should hit pause, but I just can't seem to press it. I wanted to see whether this place is really the perfect work-life balance.

scenes.title_en: Canggu: The Hub of Digital Nomads
scenes.context: 博主要去仓谷，因为那里有很多数字游民。接机导游夫妇就住在仓谷，说仓谷「很疯狂」——晚上出去狂欢，第二天人就少了。语域：旅行对话，猎奇语气。
sentences: 我知道它是因为那边有很多数字游民。
I know the place because there are a lot of digital nomads there.
digital nomads（数字游民）；there are a lot of（有很多）
仓谷很疯狂，现在很疯狂。
Canggu is crazy — it's really crazy right now.
crazy（疯狂）；口语强调：is crazy / really crazy
到底仓谷是一个什么样的地方，为什么会有这么多数字游民会来到这里呢？
What kind of place is Canggu, and why do so many digital nomads come here?
What kind of place（什么样的地方）；so many（这么多）
paraphrase: 数字游民 → digital nomads / remote workers
digital nomads · remote workers
聚集地 → a hub / a hotspot
hub · hotspot
scenes.speak: I know the place because there are a lot of digital nomads there. Canggu is crazy — it's really crazy right now. What kind of place is Canggu, and why do so many digital nomads come here?

scenes.title_cn: Tropical No.1 共享办公空间
scenes.context: 来到共享办公空间 Tropical No.1，24小时开放，有来自世界各地的远程工作者。很多人一边在巴厘岛生活一边经营事业：早上冲浪、白天办公、傍晚看日落。语域：现场探访口播。
sentences: 这里的共享办公空间24小时开放，有来自世界各地的远程工作者。
This coworking space is open twenty-four hours, filled with remote workers from all over the world.
coworking space（共享办公空间）；remote workers（远程工作者）
很多人一边在巴厘岛生活，一边经营着自己的事业。
Many people live in Bali while running their own businesses.
run one's own business（经营自己的事业）；while doing（一边…一边…）
早上冲浪，白天办公，傍晚再去看日落。
Surf in the morning, work during the day, then watch the sunset in the evening.
surf（冲浪）；watch the sunset（看日落）
paraphrase: 共享办公空间 → coworking space / shared office
coworking · shared office
经营事业 → run one's own business / build a career
run a business · build a career
scenes.speak: This coworking space is open twenty-four hours, filled with remote workers from all over the world. Many people live in Bali while running their own businesses. Surf in the morning, work during the day, then watch the sunset in the evening.

scenes.title_cn: 采访数字游民：AI让你这样生活
scenes.title_en: Interviewing Nomads: AI Lets You Live Like This
scenes.context: 博主随机采访在共享空间办公的人：来自万隆的Dika、来自尼日利亚的菲蒂。问了好几个人同一个问题「担不担心AI抢饭碗」，有意思的是他们大多认为是AI才让他们可以这样生活。语域：现场采访，轻松对话。
sentences: 在这里你几乎什么都能做，你可以轻松地与人交谈。
Here you can do almost anything — you can easily strike up a conversation with people.
strike up a conversation（攀谈、交谈）
现在我基本上是醒来然后去办公室，然后工作工作工作。
Now basically I wake up, head to the office, and work, work, work.
wake up（醒来）；head to the office（去办公室）
你担不担心AI抢你的饭碗？他们大多认为是AI才让他们可以这样生活。
Are you worried about AI taking your job? Most said it's AI that lets them live like this.
take your job（抢你饭碗）；lets them live like this（让他们这样生活）
paraphrase: 攀谈 → strike up a conversation / easily talk to people
strike up · talk to people
抢饭碗 → take your job / put you out of work
take your job · out of work
scenes.speak: Here you can do almost anything — you can easily strike up a conversation with people. Now basically I wake up, head to the office, and work, work, work. Are you worried about AI taking your job? Most said it's AI that lets them live like this.

scenes.title_en: The Odalan Festival: A Celebration Every 210 Days
scenes.context: 来到乌布一户正在举办庆典的人家：这是巴厘岛家庙每210天举行一次的重要仪式，分散各地的家族成员都会回来祭拜神明和祖先，感谢庇佑。语域：人文讲解旁白。
sentences: 原来这个是巴厘岛家庙，每210天才会举行的一次重要仪式。
So this is a Balinese family temple — an important ritual held only once every 210 days.
family temple（家庙）；an important ritual（重要仪式）
到了这一天，分散在各地的家族成员都会尽量赶回来。
On this day, family members scattered across the island try their best to come back.
scattered across（分散在…各地）；come back（赶回来）
一起祭拜神明和祖先，感谢庇佑。
Together they honor the gods and ancestors and give thanks for their blessings.
honor the gods（祭拜神明）；give thanks for（感谢）
paraphrase: 分散各地 → scattered across / spread out in different places
scattered · spread out
感谢庇佑 → give thanks for their blessings / show gratitude
give thanks · gratitude
scenes.speak: So this is a Balinese family temple — an important ritual held only once every 210 days. On this day, family members scattered across the island try their best to come back. Together they honor the gods and ancestors and give thanks for their blessings.

scenes.title_cn: 制作 canang sari 小花篮
scenes.context: 博主跟着体验制作巴厘岛日常供品 canang sari 小花篮：看似简单的小花篮，从选花到摆放都有讲究，不同颜色的花朵对应不同方位的守护神明。语域：体验口播，带文化说明。
sentences: 我也跟着体验了一把，来制作这个 canang sari。
I got to try it myself — making these canang sari.
try it myself（亲自体验）；canang sari（巴厘岛供品小花篮）
原来这些看似简单的小花篮，从选花到摆放都有讲究。
These seemingly simple flower baskets have rules for everything, from choosing the flowers to arranging them.
seemingly simple（看似简单）；have rules for everything（处处有讲究）
不同颜色的花朵，分别对应不同方位的守护神明。
Different colored flowers correspond to the guardian deities of different directions.
correspond to（对应）；guardian deities（守护神明）
paraphrase: 亲自体验 → try it myself / experience it firsthand
try it myself · firsthand
有讲究 → have rules for everything / there's a tradition to it
have rules · a tradition to it
scenes.speak: I got to try it myself — making these canang sari. These seemingly simple flower baskets have rules for everything, from choosing the flowers to arranging them. Different colored flowers correspond to the guardian deities of different directions.

scenes.context: 在一家抹茶小木屋休息，吹着冷气看着外面绿油油的稻田，喝一杯抹茶，博主觉得很peace。之后去逛纪念品商店，AI眼镜帮忙识别巴厘岛风景画和巴龙面具的价格。语域：休闲口播+科技体验。
sentences: 坐在这个小木屋里面，吹着冷气，看着外面绿油油的稻田。
Sitting in this little wooden cabin with the AC on, looking out at the lush green rice paddies.
wooden cabin（小木屋）；rice paddies（稻田）；lush green（绿油油）
再喝一杯这样子的抹茶，会让你觉得非常的peace。
And sipping a cup of matcha like this makes you feel so at peace.
sip a cup of matcha（喝一杯抹茶）；feel at peace（感到平和）
我逛了一圈下来，我感觉问他什么都知道，尤其是这个价格猜得特别的准。
After walking through the whole store, it seemed to know everything I asked — especially the prices, which it nailed.
nail a price（猜得准）；it seemed to know（好像什么都知道）
paraphrase: 绿油油的稻田 → lush green rice paddies / verdant rice fields
lush · verdant · rice paddies
很平和 → feel at peace / totally chill
at peace · chill
scenes.speak: Sitting in this little wooden cabin with the AC on, looking out at the lush green rice paddies. And sipping a cup of matcha like this makes you feel so at peace. After walking through the whole store, it seemed to know everything I asked — especially the prices, which it nailed.

scenes.context: 金巴兰海滩以超美的海上日落闻名，被评为全球十大最美日落之一。博主静静坐着看太阳一点一点掉进海里，那个在上海怎么也找不到的暂停键好像就这么被按下了。语域：旁白收尾，诗意哲思。
sentences: 你眼前的是金巴兰海滩，它以超美的海上日落而闻名。
Before you is Jimbaran Beach, famous for its stunning ocean sunsets.
be famous for（以…闻名）；stunning sunsets（超美的日落）
只想静静地坐着，看太阳一点一点掉进海里。
I just want to sit quietly and watch the sun sink little by little into the sea.
sink into the sea（掉进海里）；little by little（一点一点）
那个我在上海怎么也找不到的暂停键，好像就这么被按下了。
The pause button I could never find in Shanghai seems to have been pressed, just like that.
the pause button（暂停键）；just like that（就这么）
paraphrase: 以…闻名 → be famous for / be known for
famous for · known for
一点一点 → little by little / bit by bit
little by little · bit by bit
scenes.speak: Before you is Jimbaran Beach, famous for its stunning ocean sunsets. I just want to sit quietly and watch the sun sink little by little into the sea. The pause button I could never find in Shanghai seems to have been pressed, just like that.

practice: 说你想按下生活的暂停键
I keep telling myself to hit pause, but my schedule is just packed.
They surf in the morning, work during the day, and watch the sunset in the evening.
Are you worried about AI taking your job?
I sat quietly and watched the sun sink little by little into the sea.
pitfalls: The space is open 24 hours all over the world.
The coworking space is open 24 hours, with remote workers from all over the world.
all over the world 修饰的是「来自哪里的人」，不能用来形容空间的开放时间。
I want to press a pause key.
「按暂停键」英文惯用 hit pause / press pause，不逐字说 pause key。
Different flowers correspond to the guardian deities.
correspond to 是固定搭配，介词 to 不能省略。
The beach is famous by sunset.
The beach is famous for its stunning sunsets.
be famous for（因…而闻名）；by 表达方式/手段，语义不对。
shifts: 用 get completely packed（塞满）、jam-packed（爆满）、run from thing to thing
用 stunning（绝美）、lush green（绿油油）、gorgeous
用 hit pause（按下暂停键）、feel at peace（平和）、unwind（放松下来）
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已校正：芭蕾岛→巴厘岛、仓谷→仓古/Canggu、井里→锦鲤、Sacling Tea→Suckling pig烤乳猪、苍狼砂礼→canang sari、Tanang Sari→Canang Sari、乌布→乌布、金巴兰→金巴兰、奥德兰→Odalan、巴龙→巴龙面具、巴黎尼斯→巴厘岛等。
